notes: Bitmap 2 expands the original bitcrusher with waveshaping, wavefolding and a window comparator, fractional bit reduction from 24 bits to 1 bit, sample-rate reduction from 48 kHz to 110 Hz and sample-rate modulation. Stereo TRS I/O, presets, expression/remote control and USB/TRS MIDI.

name: Buffer
notes: Compact always-on buffer using a low-noise Burr-Brown op amp, intended to prevent high-frequency loss at the start of a long pedal chain or before a long cable run. Mono, 9-18 V DC, no footswitch.

name: Context
notes: First-generation Context reverb with six algorithms (room, hall, cathedral, gated, plate and delay-plus-reverb), separate high/low damping, pre-delay and an internal trails switch. Mono, true bypass with trails off, expression/CV control.

name: Context 2
notes: Context 2 is a stereo reverb and delay with eight algorithms including room, hall, cathedral, gated, reverse, plate, spring and granular reverb. Each algorithm has low/high damping, pre-delay, modulation, dynamics, infinite hold and a switchable delay; spring mode adds tremolo.

name: Mixer
notes: Small always-on two-input mono mixer for pedalboards: combine instruments into one amp, sum parallel effect chains, or create a clean analog dry blend. Each input has its own level control; 9-18 V DC.

name: Particle
notes: The original Particle granular delay/pitch shifter, released in 2011. It slices the input into 15-250 ms grains and rearranges or pitch-shifts them across eight modes, with freeze, expression/CV control, true bypass and a fully analog dry path.

name: Particle V2
notes: Particle 2 is a stereo granular delay and pitch shifter with five delay modes and three pitch modes, +/-1 octave shifting, 0-2.5 s delay, adjustable grain size/density, freeze, presets and full MIDI control. It adds stereo I/O, higher fidelity and a smaller enclosure over the original.

name: Radius
notes: Radius is a stereo ring modulator and frequency shifter built on an eight-quadrant multiplier algorithm, with continuous blending between ring mod and frequency shifting, selectable 2x upper/lower sidebands, pitch tracking, a push-to-tune carrier and a multi-waveform LFO/step sequencer. MIDI-playable carrier, 96 kHz processing and expression/MIDI control.

name: Raster
notes: Original Raster: a digital delay with a pitch/phase/frequency shifter in the feedback loop, up to 750 ms delay, three shift modes and three feedback types. Mono, true bypass, expression/CV control; the later Raster 2 added stereo I/O, USB MIDI and a larger feature set.

name: Raster 2
notes: Raster 2 is a stereo digital delay with pitch and frequency shifting in the feedback loop: up to 1600 ms delay (3200 ms forward via the editor), +/-12 semitone shifting, detune and phase/frequency shifting, reverse delay, seven modulation waveforms, and series/parallel/ping-pong routing. MIDI clock, presets and a web editor.

name: RD-1 Pitch Delay
notes: RD-1 is a compact mono digital delay distilled from the Raster, adding three shift modes: chromatic +/-12 semitones, continuous detune from a fourth down to a major third up, and frequency shifting to +/-500 Hz. Delay runs to 1200 ms (2400 ms in reverse), with assignable expression/tap control and USB-C firmware updates. No MIDI or presets.

name: Remote 4
notes: Passive four-footswitch remote for Red Panda pedals, connected with a 1/4 in TRS cable. It provides four modes per host pedal for preset recall, bypass, tap tempo, hold/freeze and looper functions, with erasable scribble strips. No power required.

name: Tensor
notes: Tensor is a real-time time-warp pedal: reverse, tape stop/start, speed and pitch changes, time stretching from 1:4 to 4:1, and looping/overdub up to 9.4 s (4.7 s in stereo). It is always listening, supports momentary or latching footswitches, expression/remote control and USB/TRS MIDI.

name: Cinders Overdrive
notes: Analog transparent overdrive with Drive, Level, Bass and Treble controls; true bypass.

name: Corona Chorus
notes: TonePrint stereo chorus with SCF and Tri-Chorus modes and custom artist TonePrints.

name: Corona Mini Chorus
notes: Mini TonePrint chorus with Speed, Depth and Level controls; true bypass.

name: Dark Matter Distortion
notes: Analog distortion with Gain, Level, Voice and Treble controls; true bypass.

name: Ditto 2 Looper
notes: Compact looper with the Ditto app (loop storage/management) over USB-C, loop level knob and Pair/User/Ditto side switch.

name: Ditto Jam X2 Looper
notes: Two-track looper with BeatSense automatic BPM detection that keeps loops in time with a live band or backing track.

name: Canvas Power 15
notes: 15-output isolated power supply: 13 × 9 V 500 mA + 2 variable 9/12/18 V outputs + USB-C 5 V 1.5 A charging; 96 W 24 V brick.

name: Canvas Power 22
notes: 22-output isolated power supply: 20 × 9 V 500 mA + 2 variable 9/12/18 V outputs + USB-C 5 V 1.5 A charging; 96 W 24 V brick.

name: Canvas Power 5
notes: 5-output isolated power supply: 4 × 9 V 500 mA + 1 variable 9/12/18 V output; 48 W 24 V brick.

name: Canvas Power 8
notes: 8-output isolated power supply: 6 × 9 V 500 mA + 2 variable 9/12/18 V outputs + USB-C 5 V 1.5 A charging; 48 W 24 V brick.

name: Canvas Power HP
notes: Hybrid power supply with one 3 A 9/12 V output for modelers and three 9 V 500 mA isolated outputs; 48 W 24 V brick.

name: Canvas Re-Amp
notes: Passive transformer-isolated re-amp box for sending line-level DAW tracks back through pedals and amps; XLR and 1/4 in inputs, 1/4 in output, ground lift, phase invert, mute, and high-pass filter.

name: Canvas Rehearsal
notes: All-in-one practice tool: headphone amp, Bluetooth/1/8 in aux playback, metronome (40–250 BPM), and MIDI In/Thru control.

name: EB-10 Preamp // EQ // Boost
notes: Preamp/EQ/boost with three presets, 12 dB boost/cut low/mid/high bands, and a 10 dB MOSFET boost.
